seed_ledger.name: Chickasha industrial park power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: Southwest Ledger (June 2025) says Energy Transfer will connect the Citizen Capital and Lightfield Energy behind-the-meter gas plant, meant to power a data center at the Chickasha airport industrial park, to at least one of two high-pressure gas lines near the airport. No new pipe or length stated. Energy Transfer owns Enable Gas Transmission (P0161); the article does not name the line, so P0161 is the likeliest tap and a DataCenter tag lead only. Plant is still announced, seeking power customers.

evidence.note: names Energy Transfer, the two high-pressure lines, Lightfield plant and data center at Chickasha airport park; line not named
